sloka: तन्मेरुशिखराकारं द्योतमानमिव श्रिया।द्वे शते वानरेन्द्राणां पतमानमपातयत् ।। ६.६७.११४ ।।
transliteration: tanmeruśikharākāraṁ dyotamānamiva śriyā।dve śate vānarendrāṇāṁ patamānamapātayat ।। 6.67.114 ।।

translations.english: When that Rakshasa made such boastful and dreadful statements in the battlefield, laughing heartily, Saumitri replied as follows.
